import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

# Data
openvla_k = [1.00, 0.95, 0.90, 0.70, 0.50, 0.30]
openvla_sr = [74.0, 69.4, 62.0, 49.0, 37.4, 20.6]

smolvla_k = [1.00, 0.95, 0.90, 0.70, 0.50]
smolvla_sr = [44.8, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]

smolvla_off_k = [1.00, 0.50]
smolvla_off_sr = [59.2, 0.0]

# Colors
c_smol = '#D55E00'
c_smol_off = '#E8A070'
c_open = '#0072B2'

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.2, 3.2))

# Shaded region for cliff-edge collapse
ax.fill_between([0.28, 0.97], -2, 2.5, color=c_smol, alpha=0.06, zorder=0)
ax.annotate('cliff-edge\ncollapse', xy=(0.63, 1.2), fontsize=7.5,
            color=c_smol, alpha=0.7, ha='center', va='bottom',
            style='italic')

# Plot lines
ax.plot(openvla_k, openvla_sr, '-s', color=c_open, markersize=6,
        markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.8, zorder=3,
        label='OpenVLA (74.0%)')

ax.plot(smolvla_k, smolvla_sr, '-o', color=c_smol, markersize=6,
        markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.8, zorder=3,
        label='SmolVLA (ours, 44.8%)')

ax.plot(smolvla_off_k, smolvla_off_sr, '--^', color=c_smol_off, markersize=6,
        markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.8, zorder=3,
        label='SmolVLA (official, 59.2%)')

# Axis config
ax.set_xlim(0.25, 1.05)
ax.set_ylim(-3, 82)
ax.set_xlabel('Fraction of Tokens Retained')
ax.set_ylabel('Success Rate (%)')
ax.set_xticks([0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1.0])
ax.set_yticks([0, 20, 40, 60, 80])

# Annotate "graded degradation" along OpenVLA curve
mid_x = 0.70
mid_y = 49.0
ax.annotate('graded\ndegradation', xy=(mid_x, mid_y),
            xytext=(0.42, 58), fontsize=7.5, color=c_open, alpha=0.8,
            style='italic', ha='center',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c_open, alpha=0.5, lw=1.0))

ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True, fancybox=False,
          edgecolor='#cccccc', framealpha=0.95, borderpad=0.5)

ax.axhline(y=0, color='#888888', linewidth=0.5, linestyle='-', zorder=1)

plt.tight_layout()

out = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-be-idea-gen-0515-2/projects/importance_margin_vla_compress/docs/paper/figures/paper/fig_degradation_curve.pdf'
fig.savefig(out)
plt.close()

import os
size = os.path.getsize(out)
print(f'Saved: {out} ({size} bytes)')
assert size > 10000, f'File too small: {size} bytes'
print('OK')
